generationPrompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural / identity-preserve. Create one refined alternate fashion photograph based on the reference. One single portrait 2:3 frame, NOT a collage. Preserve this exact adult fictional East Asian woman, short dark bob, ivory asymmetric one-shoulder draped midi dress, burgundy envelope clutch in the same hand, black pointed kitten heels, and the identical sunlit stone colonnade street. Change only her pose: her shoulders, hips and feet turn together roughly 55 degrees toward image right, a calm natural three-quarter SIDE view, with face gently turned back toward the camera. Relaxed arm with the clutch clearly visible against her side, natural hands; do not invent dress details. The camera stays fixed, same focal length/background perspective, warm light and exposure. Place full head at y5%, soles at y93%, center body at x50%, same model scale as reference. Complete head and both shoes, even headroom/footroom. Keep clothes, color, tailoring and accessory details identical. No text, borders, logos, extra people, motion blur, mirrored outfit or close-up.
